fields.label: Phone Number ID
fields.description: Meta’s numeric ID for this registered sender, not the phone number itself. Copy the Phone Number ID from your WhatsApp API setup or Meta’s phone-number lookup. Meta: find the Phone Number ID

fields.label: Access Token
fields.description: Authorizes API requests for this WhatsApp account. Sending requires whatsapp_business_messaging; template sync requires whatsapp_business_management. Stored encrypted in this app. Meta: access tokens and permissions

fields.label: Label
fields.description: A unique name for this sender inside the app. Choose a name your team will recognize. App sender setup

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Allows this sender to upload media to WhatsApp Cloud, send messages and process inbound events. The separate outbound, inbound and automation switches in WhatsApp Settings must also allow the operation. Leave off while preparing the account. App sender setup

fields.label: Waba Id
fields.description: The WhatsApp Business Account ID that owns this phone number. Required in this app for approved-template sync and inbound account matching. Meta: find the WABA ID

fields.label: Portfolio Id
fields.description: Optional Meta Business Portfolio ID. This app uses it to recognize the same contact across sender accounts in that portfolio. If blank, contacts are grouped by WABA ID, or by the individual sender if WABA ID is also blank. Meta: business portfolio ID

fields.label: Display Phone
fields.description: Optional readable version of this sender’s phone number, including its country code. Used as account information in this app; sending uses Phone Number ID. Meta: phone number details
